defect_1_local_containerized.summary: circular type dependency between packages/mcp-license and servers/timezone means no Dockerfile in the monorepo can build
defect_1_local_containerized.detail: packages/mcp-license/src/profile.ts:5 imports @theluckystrike/mcp-timezone/lib, while servers/timezone/src/index.ts:8 imports @theluckystrike/mcp-license. Every servers/*/Dockerfile runs a linear `npm run build --workspace` sequence, so whichever is built first fails with TS2307.
defect_1_local_containerized.evidence_barcode: docker buildx build -f servers/barcode/Dockerfile . -> src/index.ts(8,87): error TS2307: Cannot find module '@theluckystrike/mcp-license' (order timezone,license)
defect_1_local_containerized.evidence_invoice: docker buildx build -f servers/invoice/Dockerfile . -> src/profile.ts(5,29): error TS2307: Cannot find module '@theluckystrike/mcp-timezone/lib' (order license,invoice)
defect_1_local_containerized.scope: all 32 servers/*/Dockerfile; dist/ is gitignored (.gitignore:3) so the image must compile from source
defect_1_local_containerized.owner: servers/ owner; NOT fixed by the directory agent, which is forbidden to edit servers/*

defect_2_mirror_repos.summary: every mirror repo ships the monorepo Dockerfile verbatim, referencing packages/ and servers/ directories the mirror does not contain
defect_2_mirror_repos.evidence: git clone theluckystrike/mcp-invoice && docker buildx build . -> ERROR: failed to compute cache key: "/servers": not found
defect_2_mirror_repos.irony: the mirror repo is otherwise self-contained: package.json declares "@theluckystrike/mcp-license": "file:vendor/mcp-license" and vendor/mcp-license/dist is prebuilt and committed, so a correct 6-line Dockerfile would build

defect_3_remote_path.summary: the hosted endpoints cannot be listed as no-OAuth remote servers because MCP traffic is 401
defect_3_remote_path.correction: an unauthenticated GET returns 200 with a JSON self-description including "transport": "streamable-http", but that is a description page, not a working MCP endpoint
defect_3_remote_path.evidence: POST {jsonrpc:2.0,method:initialize} -> HTTP 401, www-authenticate: Bearer realm="mcp.zovo.one", error="invalid_token"
defect_3_remote_path.note: this is the same 401 that makes Glama mark our four connectors 'Server is not responding' (round 25 finding)

docker_followup.next_loop_task: Fix defect 1 (reorder or break the license<->timezone cycle, e.g. build the shared lib without the timezone import, or add a tsc project-references build) and rebuild servers/barcode/Dockerfile locally until `docker run` lists tools. Then open ONE docker/mcp-registry PR for that server. Alternatively fix defect 3 by exposing one unauthenticated read-only endpoint and submit it as type: remote, which needs no Dockerfile at all.
